about:
Pacifica Foods Company was founded in 1972 in Vernon, California. The company has specialized in specialty food imports since its inception. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates as a specialty food distributor, focusing on Italian-sourced products. Its portfolio includes the Le 5 Stagioni line of Type 00 flours — such as Pizza Napoletana (W 300, -10/+20), Superior (W 330, -10/+30), and Pasta Fresca varieties — as well as a gluten-free flour option packaged in 20/500g units. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Pacifica Foods serves the food service sector, supplying pizzerias, bakeries, and other commercial kitchens that require authentic Italian flour. The company's website identifies it as a specialty food distributor, indicating a focus on professional culinary operations rather than retail consumers.

The company states that its founding principle was a passion for specialty food imports, and it emphasizes providing customers and partners with strong service at competitive prices. No further differentiation claims such as certifications or exclusive distribution rights are publicly documented.
